## About
Central Tire Corporation is a tire shop in Medley built around the commercial trucking industry. Our technicians handle all aspects of tire service and repair, from mounting tires on multi-piece rims to inflating them to the right PSI for the load.
We also serve the port's forklifts and rental equipment with solid tires, offer foam fill, and balance wheels for trucks and automobiles. Our goal is simple: a friendly team, quality products at a fair price, and a long business relationship with every customer.
Customers on Google rate us 4.1 from 105 reviews.

## Services
- 24/7 service: Service is available around the clock, because service is our priority.
- Fleet tire information: Timely tire information for your fleet, including air, pressure and wear, to help tires last longer and keep costs down.
- Tire mounting and dismounting: We dismount and mount any type of tire on drop center, semi-drop center and multi-piece rims.
- Forklifts and rental equipment: We serve the port's forklifts and rental equipment.

## FAQ
Q: Is the shop open on Saturday?
A: Yes. The Medley shop is open Saturday from 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM and closed on Sunday.

Q: Do you have a location in Broward?
A: Yes. Central Tire Broward & Palm Beach is at 2801 S. Andrew Ave. in Ft. Lauderdale. That location is closed on Saturday.

Q: Can wholesalers check inventory and prices online?
A: Yes. Log in to the inventory database on our website and open the Inventory tab to see inventory and prices. Add your information in the comments when you submit an order and we will contact you for payment and delivery.
